import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis';
import { FIBER_STATE } from "../fiber-state.js";
/**
 * 起一个真实的 Cordis `Context`，先 provide 装配层服务，再逐个装载插件并等它们 settle。
 * 任一插件启动失败（config 或插件体抛出）时整个装配抛出——测试里不允许「装配成功但某个面不可用」。
 */
export async function bootAssembly(options) {
    const ctx = new Context();
    const fibers = [];
    const disposeAll = async () => {
        for (const fiber of [...fibers].reverse())
            await fiber.dispose();
    };
    try {
        const services = options.services ?? [];
        if (services.length > 0) {
            const host = ctx.plugin({
                name: 'assembly-services',
                apply(inner) {
                    for (const service of services)
                        inner.provide(service.name, service.value);
                },
            });
            fibers.push(await host);
        }
        for (const entry of options.plugins ?? []) {
            const fiber = ctx.plugin(entry.plugin, entry.config);
            fibers.push(fiber);
            if (fiber.state === FIBER_STATE.PENDING) {
                // 清单错误：必需服务不在前面的插件里，等下去只会静默挂起
                throw new Error(`plugin "${String(entry.plugin.name)}" is PENDING: a required service is not provided by the plugins loaded before it`);
            }
            await fiber;
        }
    }
    catch (error) {
        // 部分装配失败：先撤已装的（含失败那一个），不留半个装配
        await disposeAll().catch(() => undefined);
        throw error;
    }
    return { ctx, fibers, dispose: disposeAll };
}
/** 等待一个 fiber 进入 ACTIVE 或以启动错误拒绝；供需要观察中间状态的测试使用。 */
export async function settle(fiber) {
    return await fiber;
}
export { FIBER_STATE };
//# sourceMappingURL=index.js.map
